name: Jurassick
source:
Three dino princes. One destined mate. And you. This can’t be right — dinosaurs were meant to be scaly... maybe a bit feathered... but certainly not this charming.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
三个恐龙王子。一位命中注定的伴侣。你呢。这是不对的——恐龙本来就是有鳞的……也许有点羽毛……但肯定不是这么迷人。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
